summary: Gone: a 1916 two-story log cabin at Rocky Point near Sweet Home, removed or destroyed in the 1940s; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed in the 1940s (register, c.1945 per Oregon Lookouts), or destroyed then per firelookout.com. No source describes the site now.

events.note: Telephone line to Rocky Point with Mr. Brady in charge of the lookout station (Albany Democrat, as quoted)
Oregon Lookouts dates removal to c.1945; register says 1940s; firelookout.com says destroyed in the 1940s
Registered May 12, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: About 3 miles northeast of Sweet Home
Oregon Lookouts refers to the Linn County Fire Patrol
1913 telephone line; Mr. Brady in charge of the lookout station
evidence.quote: A telephone line from Whitcomes, on the middle fork of the Santiam, to Rocky Point with Mr. Brady in charge of the lookout station.

evidence.supports: Built in 1916 as a two-story log cabin; removed in the 1940s
evidence.quote: Built in 1916, this two-story log cabin was removed in the 1940s.

evidence.supports: 1916 two-story log cabin; destroyed in the 1940s

evidence.quote: 1916: A two story log cabin structure was erected.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and Oregon Lookouts say removed (1940s; c.1945). firelookout.com says destroyed in the 1940s. The story reports both verbs and the shared decade.
The register and firelookout.com say Linn FPA; Oregon Lookouts says Linn County Fire Patrol. These are probably the same body. The brief's 'Linn FPA' is kept.

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches the sources on status, 1916 build, 2011 registration and agency; no corrections proposed. Do not conflate with other Rocky Point sites: firetower.org 'Rocky Point Lookout Site' (US 732, Lincoln County; cabin built 1920s and gone by the 1950s; http://www.firetower.org/lookouts/us/or/rocky-point-lookout-site/) and a second Rocky Point page on oregonlookouts.weebly.com (rocky-point.html; 1913 station, Section 16 T4N R5W), which I saw only as a search snippet and did not read. No source describes the site today; access is unknown and not set. Linn County Fire Patrol Association records (University of Oregon, 1911-1963) appeared in search results but were not read.
